decision_vector: D1=D D2=C D3=C D4=E D5=A D6=B D7=B D8=C D9=C D10=C D11=C
inventory_pin: sha256(inspect.getsource(view)) + pins of wrapped base functions; fixed by M1-1A before search

nomination.rank: sel_pass_rate desc, steps asc, digest asc

proposer: native type-directed enumeration, length then lexicographic step names
random_search_arm: 20 uniform draws over all 584 symbol lists, seed random_search_arm_seed; counted separately from max_proposals; report-only
each_catch: StructuredMissionError only; records (element_index, str(error)); other exceptions = whole-source failure; no nesting
error_channel: each-captured errors written to quarantined in index order, identical for every workflow/arm; no each => quarantined []
